description: This file defines an abstract class 'StaticContentData' representing static content data in a content management system. It includes attributes for filename, content type, and file content type, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: StaticContentData
classes.description: An abstract class that encapsulates common attributes for static content, such as filename, content type, and content type string.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the static content.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the static content.

methods.name: getFileContentType
methods.description: Returns the file content type as a string.

methods.name: setFileContentType
methods.description: Sets the file content type as a string.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type using the FileContentType enum.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type as a FileContentType enum.
